D: A cat burglar fresh out of prison is recruited to wear a suit that shrinks him to the size of an ant.
P: Serve the snacks when Luis starts one of his very long stories.
S: Luis telling a story that goes on and on
Corn tortillas rolled tight around chicken and cheese, baked until crisp and served with sour cream.
the ants that do all the work
Lavash brushed with oil, sprinkled with black and white sesame seeds in a trail pattern, baked crisp at 180C, with a whipped feta dip.
M: dinner at Hank Pym's old house in San Francisco

Salmon baked under a crust of breadcrumbs, parsley, lemon zest, parmesan and Dijon, with roast baby potatoes and a crunchy fennel and orange salad. Heat the oven to 200C. Toss 800g halved baby potatoes in oil and salt and roast 30 minutes. Mix 60g breadcrumbs, 30g grated parmesan, chopped parsley, the zest of a lemon and 2 tbsp melted butter. Spread 4 salmon fillets with 1 tsp Dijon each, press on the crumb and bake for 12 minutes. Shave 1 fennel bulb thin and toss with segments of 2 oranges, olive oil, lemon juice and salt.
Flour tortillas filled with grilled chicken, rice, black beans, cheese, salsa and sour cream, rolled tight and toasted in a dry pan.
W: Ice cream shop hot fudge brownie sundaes
the ice cream shop job he gets fired from

Warm fudgy brownie squares topped with vanilla ice cream, hot fudge sauce, whipped cream, chopped peanuts and a cherry. Melt 150g dark chocolate with 120g butter. Whisk in 200g caster sugar and 2 eggs, then fold in 80g plain flour and 2 tbsp cocoa. Bake in a lined 20cm tin at 175C for 25 minutes and cool slightly. Heat 150ml cream until steaming and stir in 120g chopped dark chocolate until smooth. Put a warm brownie square in each bowl, top with 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, peanuts and a cherry.
K: everything shrunk down to ant size

Fresh lemonade blended with raspberries and mint, strained and served icy cold in shot glasses on a tray, a tiny raspberry on each rim. Blend 150g raspberries with the juice of 5 lemons, 100g caster sugar and a handful of mint, then strain into a jug. Add 500ml chilled soda water and stir. Line up shot glasses on a tray, fill each and hang a single raspberry on the rim. Keep the jug in the fridge for refills.

s.note: the ants that do all the work
s.how: Brush 2 sheets lavash with olive oil and sprinkle 1 tbsp each black and white sesame seeds in winding trails. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp and snap into shards. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and a little oil for dipping.

s.note: Luis telling a story that goes on and on
s.how: Mix 300g shredded cooked chicken with 100g grated cheddar and 2 tbsp salsa. Roll a spoonful tightly in each of 12 warmed small corn tortillas, brush with oil and bake seam-side down at 220C for 15 minutes until crisp. Serve with sour cream.

m.how: Grill 600g chicken thighs and slice. Cook 200g rice. Fill 4 large flour tortillas with chicken, rice, a tin of black beans, 100g cheddar, salsa and sour cream. Roll tight and toast in a dry pan.
